boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Upland destinations on corridors near Taylor University, each with a specific practical reason to stop.

cards.title: Upland Park — picnic-table pause
cards.subtitle: Washington Street corridor
cards.notes: Head to 405 W. Washington Street for the listed shelters, picnic tables, grills, basketball courts, restrooms, and open play areas.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street park with several listed recreation amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Upland Park at 405 W. Washington Street includes a community building, shelters, picnic tables, grills, basketball courts, play equipment, restrooms, and open play areas.
cards.access_notes: Park amenities are listed by the Upland Parks Department; check local conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Upland Depot Park — caboose and gazebo
cards.subtitle: Railroad Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk to 107 Railroad Street to see the park’s listed play train and caboose, then use the benches or gazebo for a short outdoor stop.
cards.short_summary: A Railroad Street park centered on rail-themed features.
cards.evidence_claim: Upland Depot Park at 107 Railroad Street includes a play train, caboose, benches, and gazebo.
cards.access_notes: Park amenities are listed by the Upland Parks Department; check local conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Jefferson Township Memorial Park — corner stop
cards.subtitle: Jefferson and Main Streets corridor
cards.notes: Use the named park at the corner of Jefferson and Main Streets as a defined outdoor waypoint while exploring the downtown-side Main Street corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named park at the Jefferson–Main corner.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson Township Memorial Park is located at the corner of Jefferson and Main Streets in Upland.
cards.access_notes: The town lists this as a Upland park; check local conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Dream Big Park — stream-side tables
cards.subtitle: Railroad Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 79 Railroad Street for the listed stream, picnic tables, and shelter when you want a compact outdoor break near the depot area.
cards.short_summary: A Railroad Street park with a stream, tables, and shelter.
cards.evidence_claim: Dream Big Park at 79 Railroad Street includes a stream, picnic tables, and a shelter.
cards.access_notes: Park amenities are listed by the Upland Parks Department; check local conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Upland Pupland — fenced dog areas
cards.subtitle: Washington Street corridor
cards.notes: If you are visiting with a dog, use the two fenced leash-free play areas listed at 405 W. Washington Street rather than an unnamed open field.
cards.short_summary: A named dog-park area at Upland Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Upland Pupland at 405 W. Washington Street has two fenced areas for dogs to play leash-free.
cards.access_notes: Follow posted park rules and supervise pets; check local conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Upland Post Office — mail errand
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the named post office at 222 N. Main Street when you need a local mailing stop along the Main Street corridor north of campus.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street location for postal errands.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor University lists the Upland Post Office at 222 N. Main Street, Upland.
cards.access_notes: Confirm postal counter availability directly before making a time-sensitive trip.

cards.title: Upland Automotive — vehicle-service stop
cards.subtitle: Washington Street corridor
cards.notes: Keep 351 W. Washington Street in mind for a clearly named local automotive-service destination when a vehicle errand takes you off campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor University lists Upland Automotive at 351 W. Washington Street, Upland.
cards.access_notes: Contact the business directly to confirm services and availability.

cards.title: Upland Tire & Service Center — tire errand
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Find this named service destination at 148 S. Main Street when a tire or vehicle-maintenance errand fits into a Main Street trip.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street destination for tire and vehicle service.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor University lists Upland Tire & Service Center at 148 S. Main Street, Upland.
cards.access_notes: Contact the business directly to confirm services and availability.

cards.title: Upland Village Laundromat — laundry stop
cards.subtitle: Berry Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the named laundromat at 87 E. Berry Avenue for a practical off-campus laundry errand on the Berry Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor University lists Upland Village Laundromat at 87 E. Berry Avenue, Upland.
cards.access_notes: Contact the business directly to confirm operating details and payment options.

cards.title: Upland Family Pharmacy — pharmacy pickup
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the named pharmacy at 1809 S. Main Street for a pharmacy-related errand on the Main Street corridor beside Taylor’s stated address.
cards.short_summary: A south Main Street pharmacy destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor University lists Upland Family Pharmacy at 1809 S. Main Street, Upland.
cards.access_notes: Contact the pharmacy directly to confirm prescription, retail, and pickup availability.
